answer: Use a harbor-gated entry with timelocked bonds. A vote counts only after an identity docks in the harbor and posts timber, a non-transferable bond from sustained work—uptime and storage proofs, never bought at once. Each epoch the harbor reshuffles its map like wind over a dune, forcing random identities to re-prove liveness, so clones cannot reuse credentials. Sybils share fingerprints; exposed as a cluster, tied identities lose timber together. Each fake needs its own long history while detection burns the batch, making scale a liability.
